keys.swarm.aura_chain_flail_desc: A flail on a chain swings behind you like a pendulum and whips out wide whenever you turn.
keys.swarm.aura_chain_flail_up: A heavier flail on a longer chain.
keys.swarm.aura_chain_flail_ten: Wrecking Star: a giant spiked star on the chain.
keys.swarm.aura_rage_ember_desc: Flames build on your body for every monster near you; when they are full they burst out around you.
keys.swarm.aura_rage_ember_ten: Berserk Flame: you stay ablaze, burning everything close.
